description: This file contains functions to fetch project names via API endpoints, primarily using axios for HTTP requests. It includes an async function 'fetchProjectNameDirect' that retrieves the project name given a project ID, with fallback handling if the API client isn't available. Additionally, it provides a deprecated alias 'fetchProjectNameByProjectId'.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameDirect(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches the project name by project ID, trying to use a custom API client if available, otherwise falling back to axios with base URL utility.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameByProjectId(projectId)
methods.description: Deprecated alias for fetchProjectNameDirect, maintained for backward compatibility.
